scope: Automatic and manual Stripe installment collection, progress/search/stats filters, attendee communications and final New Order ticket PDF/QR, organizer period summaries
image_review: Eighteen registered original application/email browser captures, including refreshed recovery and attention states, with approved #9c26dc unfilled 4 CSS pixel circles. Seventeen installment images are placed in the guide; the old manual agreement is retained as historical evidence. No browser chrome, secrets or real attendee data.

environment.data: Synthetic organizer, event, ticket, and attendees; real sandbox PaymentIntents and payment journal entries
environment.forced_due_dates: Only this sandbox order’s later due dates were advanced. Consent, entitlement, amount, status, and reconciliation guards stayed active.

checks.automatic_manual_race: passed: one persisted payment and journal entry
checks.automatic_decline: passed: no funds collected, duplicate delivery pauses
checks.automatic_replacement_card: passed: same intent recovered and replacement card saved
checks.search_stats_payment_filters: passed: browser API and pagination regression
checks.organizer_summaries: passed: native renderer and local transport; duplicate runs do not resend
checks.attendee_communications: passed: initial receipt, payment receipts, failure email, standard New Order final delivery
checks.ticket_pdf_qr: passed: actual generated PDFs visually reviewed
checks.strict_email_build_failure: passed: retry rather than mark delivered
checks.authenticated_dispatcher: passed: OIDC identity and audience checks

limits: Code is proposed in companion PRs; automatic production collection is not deployed or activated. The cloud job is paused.
Existing v1 agreements remain manual; new v2 checkout consent explicitly authorizes automatic collection.
Hosted Stripe webhook transport was not exercised; actual sandbox events were signed and delivered to the local endpoint.

Email content, native renderer, PDF/QR and duplicate handling were exercised with a local transport sink; live Postmark delivery and financial rollup workers remain deployment checks. Dashboard overview money metrics are not financial acceptance evidence.
The second automatic failure fixture starts with a seeded test agreement and real sandbox deposit; the primary automatic order used actual browser checkout.
Browser 3DS challenges and enabled ticket-editor setup screenshots remain pending.
Whole dashboard TypeScript check is blocked by existing repository errors; browser build and new API/UI behavior were verified.
